quest.title: Into Eternal Night
quest.description: After passing through the dragon ruins, you reach the Night Kingdom at last. Time to search for Kachina.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1225, Mora x53900, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.title: Black Stone Under a White Stone

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you don't have to drag Paimon. You're pulling too hard!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Looks like we made it. This is the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It looks so different from what I imagined in the stories.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's Abyssal energy everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: That overflow of energy is probably what trapped Kachina here in the first place.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: From this point forward, everything we know about the real world no longer applies. Anything can happen here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's more worried about how we're gonna make it out... We obviously can't go back the way we came.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Do you see that patch of light on the ground? It's shining down from that fissure in the sky.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah, right in front of us. So, that's coming from up there... Whoa, it's so high up! Did we really fall that far down!?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Just like I said — our real-world knowledge doesn't apply here. We fell all this way, yet came out completely unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: If this was the real world, we'd have to climb our way back up to the entrance. But, here, all we have to do is stand underneath the light and offer a prayer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—That's it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, right... We've still got a job to do.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So that means all we need to do is find Kachina and bring her to this location.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: Exactly. This light is streaming in from the real world. It's a link between the two realms.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Hmm, the terrain looks difficult to navigate, and the visibility's not great, either. How are we supposed to find Kachina in these conditions?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, these floating black things don't look super friendly, either.
Those are all manifestations of Abyssal power. Be careful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: G—Ghost! A talking ghost!
Calm down, I'm here to help. You're the ones who helped Vichama, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait, does that mean you're...

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Yes. I'm Vichama's friend, Mallko. I was completely lost to this realm until I sensed a mysterious power calling out to me.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: It's like it was seeking me out, attempting to reassemble the pieces of who I used to be. Of course, it could only do so much...

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: I'm sorry I can only appear before you in this imperfect form.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: No, we should be the ones apologizing. If the Spiritspeaker Stone hadn't become corrupted by the Abyss, we could've done much more.

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: But, we had to destroy it, otherwise Vichama and his tribe would have been in danger.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Of course. Thank you for protecting him. I never imagined that, even after all these years, he'd still take such a risk for me...

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Under the power of the Stone, it felt like our souls were connected.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Turns out even our regrets were exactly the same...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Whether in triumph or death, you want your best friend by your side.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Exactly. That may not be in the cards for us, but... It's not too late for you.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: You're looking for a young girl from the Children of Echoes, right? She's being chased by an embodiment of Abyssal power.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: I'd like to help her while I'm still in this form, so follow me.

response.speaker: Mallko
response.text: Be careful. This place has been severely corroded by the Abyss.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You really think that little of Paimon? That's not even why Paimon asked!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: We're here, Kachina!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Mualani!? You made it!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Looks like our reunion will have to wait until we take care of these monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Good idea. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: D—Did you hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Never mind... It was probably just my imagination.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't scare Paimon like that!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I heard it too. It was a voice from the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek!? Wh—What did it say?

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Doesn't matter. It certainly doesn't harbor good intentions.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: You're here, you're finally here! *sobbing* Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: That monster can appear from anywhere... It almost caught me a bunch of times.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: The Wayob's power helped keep me hidden, so I just tried to stay out of sight until you got here.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Attagirl! You did so well! And most importantly, you weren't hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Should we start heading back, then?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Actually, I have a request. Will you come visit the Wayob with me?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I can't exactly put it into words, but something's wrong with the Ode of Resurrection, and I know it has something to do with the contamination from the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That was the Pyro Archon's theory as well. Everything we've seen here certainly seems to back it up.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: In the Night Kingdom, there are six main totem poles, representing the Wayob of each tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: You can think of them like the body of each Wayob. Additional totem poles, like the ones around here, serve as proxies to which the Wayob can extend their consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: There are countless proxies scattered around the Night Kingdom. Through them, the Wayob can extend their consciousness over the entire realm and track down souls no matter where they roam.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: But if a proxy were to become severely contaminated, then a soul could become lost within the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Judging by the current situation, I don't think we're dealing with just one contaminated proxy. Even if we could drive back the Abyssal power from one of them, that probably wouldn't even put a dent in the problem.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Still, we can't just leave the Wayob to suffer. It's protected me this whole time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Saving one is better than saving none at all.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I agree. We might even manage to draw out the monster that's been hunting Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Getting rid of the monster might help slow down the deterioration of the Night Kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Ugh, ugh... Argh...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Kachina? What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: N—Nothing, just a headache, and that voice again... telling me to abandon the Wayob and leave this place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe we really should leave... Kachina's already been here for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: No, I... I'm fine. I don't plan on listening to that nonsense. I can hold on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where's the totem pole?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Just up ahead. I'll lead the way. Besides, I can still fight, so please... help me out a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Listen to me, Kachina. We'll come with you, but that's because we want to help the Wayob, not because we have something to prove.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You don't have anything to prove, either. It's okay if you reach your limit. We'll be there for you.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Alright, the sooner we get this done the better.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: We've already come all this way, so we might as well try to get to the bottom of this.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Let's go. This way.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: I'll stay here and try to stall the Abyss monster.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: All by yourself!? That's too dangerous!

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: It's alright. I may not be as strong as that monster, but I'm definitely more familiar with the area. Besides...

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: I don't have much time left. If you're anything like my friend, I'm sure you're not particularly fond of goodbyes.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: So, go. Achieve your goal, and return to the world where you belong.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Thank you for everything.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You're a true hero.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: Hahaha, thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Mallko
dialogues.text: "No one fights alone."

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wayob? Wayob! I'm back! My friends and I are here to heal you!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wayob! Can you hear me? Wayob!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, we were right. The contamination is already too severe. It's preventing the Wayob from answering our calls.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Alright, get ready, everyone. Time to purge the Abyssal energy from this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help, too.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Careful. We've got company.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Already!?

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: You really think that puny soul could slow me down... Courage in the face of futility is pure folly.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: He tried to get in my way, so I disposed of him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You... You killed Mallko!?

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: He would have dispersed with or without me. Rather than worrying about him, I would urge you to focus on yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: You may have defeated others of my kind in the past, but underestimate me now, and it will be to your peril.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you the one behind all of this?

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: No. The power of the Abyss is intoxicating. The destruction it seeks captivates like a masterful work of art. I strive only for the opportunity to see it up close.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: I thought this naive little girl was an exception, but it turns out... humanity is full of lambs willing to offer themselves up to the slaughter.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: That is the tragedy of your short lives. You understand nothing of all-encompassing power.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: Ancient Names? Pride? Friendship? All empty ideas invented to give you a false sense of self-worth. They possess no power at all.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon created those grandiose ideals out of pure selfishness! Anything to avoid sharing power. Anything to avoid handing over the Primordial gift to ordinary people like you.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: Don't believe me? Then ask yourself — why is the Pyro Archon strong beyond measure, while you, Kachina, remain so pathetically weak?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Give me your hand.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Feel that? I'm right here next to you.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Thanks, Mualani. You're right... I have nothing to fear.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Because I'm not alone anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You're right... Maybe comforting ideals don't have any power.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But, you also couldn't be more wrong. You've never had to work for your own strength, so you will never understand the true source of our power.

dialogues.speaker: Comonqui
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The courage we have to stand before you and not back down... It comes from our friendship.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The power lies not in the ideal itself...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But in our commitment to upholding that ideal, and in our decision to stand together and fight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well said!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's go, Kachina. It shouldn't take more than two of us to handle an enemy like this.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Sorry in advance, but you... you deserve what's coming to you!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: There aren't many in Natlan who can beat us when we're together. It's time he got a taste of that kind of power.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: We won! We actually won!

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: That's what he gets for underestimating you two.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Fantastic work, Kachina! Absolutely fantastic!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: This makes me so... unbelievably happy...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'm happy too, Mualani. Together, we really are unstoppable, hehe!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Huh? Wh—What's happening?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: My Ancient Name... is glowing? But, I thought I didn't bring it with me...

response.speaker: Chasca
response.text: It's probably a projection from the real world, but that doesn't explain why it's glowing all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Wait, does that mean you're...!?
That was a bold move... diving head first into the fire to save your friend, especially in a place so overrun with Abyssal corruption.
Still, seeing you pull it off was really something.
Everything you said was exactly right. As isolated individuals, we stand no chance against the power of the Abyss.
It took years' worth of scars and lots of unnecessary suffering for me to understand that for myself.
The Pyro Archon's plan will unite us as one. Everyone has a part to play.
Only then will we have the power to defeat the strongest of foes.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Wh—Who are you...?

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: Tupac, a warrior from the People of the Springs. I fought against the Abyss during the invasion five hundred years ago.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I've heard that name before! You were the "Giant" who saved all of Natlan!

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: Since you were able to awaken my words from your Ancient Name, that means you've fully embodied the aspirations of the Wayob.

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: Under the Name "Umoja," you shall uni{RUBY#[D]Umoja}te the tribes and save Natlan from its impending doom.

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: "As long as blood still runs through your veins, even the tiniest spark of steel against stone can ignite a flame."

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: "Its blaze will become one with the gaze of all Natlan."

response.speaker: Tupac
response.text: "Even amid everlasting darkness, our bonds remain eternal."

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Aaagh!!!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Wh—What's wrong, Mualani?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So many memories... My brain was just flooded with everything he once knew...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: So that's what happened...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean? Did you just figure something out?

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Five hundred years ago, they foresaw the very crisis we're facing now. Efforts to save Natlan started all the way back then...

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: We can go over the details once we get back. We shouldn't linger here longer than we have to.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Does that mean... you already know about this whole thing?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I know bits and pieces, but I had no idea Mualani was also part of the plan.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: This sounds like something that's going to need a lot of explaining. Let's focus on saving the Wayob first.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Okay, that should be enough! Wayob... Wayob? Can you hear me?

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: I hear your voice, Kachina... my dear child.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Great... Well then, I'm afraid it's time to say goodbye. I just wanted to make sure you were okay before we leave, but we can't afford to stay here any longer.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I was going to ask why you bestowed an Ancient Name upon someone like me, but it's okay...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'll keep searching within myself for the answer. I'll never stop trying to improve my strength. One day, I'll live up to the hero you saw in me!

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: You are already an outstanding child in my eyes, Kachina, no matter what happens.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: You are all my most beloved children. It has always been my honor to protect and nurture you.

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: Your Ancient Name is just that... a name. Much like your parents chose to name you, "Kachina," I also gave you a name, but it need not define you.

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: Focus on who you want to be. You are already worthy of your Name. Now, you need only devote yourself to becoming a better "you."

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: The story of your Ancient Name is for you to continue. Just like your parents, my love for you will never change... no matter what the future holds.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: *sobbing* Thank you, Wayob...

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: It gladdens me to see the Pyro Archon's plan move another step towards completion, but it is time for you to leave this place. The situation here is getting worse.

response.speaker: "The Great Spirit of This Land"
response.text: Go now, my children. Save Natlan on behalf of all you hold dear.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: I know we've never met before, Wayob, but I just want to say...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Thank you for encouraging Kachina... It was exactly what she needed to hear.

choices.text: Turns out, he wasn't any stronger than the ones we've fought in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Wh—What's going on? An earthquake!?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: We're out of time.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's the power of the Abyss! Quick, we need to run!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a Seelie! The Seelie opened the way for us!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: We're... back?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon saved us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, she's not here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did she regain her strength?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... Didn't she say she used it all up?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: She's still in the Speaker's Chamber. What we saw in the Night Kingdom was just her consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're saying... Her consciousness did all that!?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: ...Every great display of power comes at a price.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: You must feel terrible, Kachina... Just hold on, we'll get you to a doctor soon.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's get back to the Stadium. The Pyro Archon said she'd have a doctor waiting for us.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: I recommend getting a full check-up, just to make sure no damage gets left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon feels okay! What about you, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm completely fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, you always seem to do pretty well against the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Let's get going. We need to share what we learned in the Night Kingdom, as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! The Wayob mentioned something about the Pyro Archon's plan. What is it, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'll let her explain everything. We're all a part of the plan now.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Every move we make from here on out will decide Natlan's ultimate fate.

dialogues.speaker: Whisper
dialogues.text: Journey... Lies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh, Paimon just heard it too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's keep going! Paimon wants to get out of this place!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Does your head still hurt? Let me help you walk.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'm fine, I'm fine! You should know I'm made of stronger stuff than that!

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You fail to escape...
